en.hero_h1: Cloud services with zero cost when idle.
en.hero_p: AWS's serverless databases, caches and schedulers still bill by the hour, as do self-hosted applications. IdleFree reimplements them on Lambda, S3 and DynamoDB: billed per request, with zero cost when idle.
en.infra_p: An AWS service, rebuilt. Same client, same API; the real service is one import away.
en.app_p: An application, unchanged, on Lambda. Its own CLI, API and UI; only the host changes.

zh.hero_h1: 空闲时零成本的云服务。
zh.hero_p: AWS 的无服务器数据库、缓存和调度服务，以及自行托管的应用，仍按小时计费。IdleFree 基于 Lambda、S3 和 DynamoDB 重新实现这些服务：按请求计费，空闲时成本为零。
zh.infra_p: 重建一个 AWS 服务。同样的客户端、同样的 API；改一行 import 就回到真服务。
zh.app_p: 现成的应用，代码不改，跑在 Lambda 上。带着它自己的命令行、API 和界面，只换宿主。
